description: Simple prompts for everyday tasks and basic interactions with ChatGPT

prompts.title: Simple Summary
prompts.prompt: Can you summarize the following text in one sentence: [text]

prompts.title: Basic Translation
prompts.prompt: Translate the following sentence from English to [language]: [sentence]

prompts.title: Spell Check
prompts.prompt: Please check the spelling and grammar of this sentence: [sentence]

prompts.title: List Generation
prompts.prompt: Make a list of [number] items related to [topic]

prompts.title: Email Template
prompts.prompt: Write a short email about [topic] to [recipient]

prompts.title: Weather Inquiry
prompts.prompt: What should I wear if it's [weather condition] outside?

prompts.title: Recipe Request
prompts.prompt: Give me a simple recipe for [dish]

prompts.title: Movie Recommendation
prompts.prompt: Can you recommend a [genre] movie for me to watch?

prompts.title: Synonym Request
prompts.prompt: What are some synonyms for the word [word]?

prompts.title: Time Zone Conversion
prompts.prompt: If it's [time] in [city], what time is it in [another city]?
